name: clinical-quality-agent
display_name: Clinical Quality and Patient Safety Agent
description: AI-powered Cortex Agent for Chief Quality Officers to analyze patient outcomes, infections, mortality rates, and safety indicators using natural language. Combines Cortex Analyst (text-to-SQL), PubMed Cortex Search (38M+ articles), and email notifications.

requires_marketplace.name: PubMed Biomedical Research Corpus
requires_marketplace.note: Strongly recommended. Enables PubMed medical literature search (38M+ articles). Agent works without it but Cortex Search tool will be unavailable.

notes: Requires PubMed Biomedical Research Corpus from Snowflake Marketplace (free). Data generation creates 75K patients with configurable quality trends. No Streamlit - uses Snowflake Intelligence UI.
